What is Pantheon Peptides?

Pantheon Peptides is a research-chemical vendor known for broad catalog availability and dependable stock. Its COA-Verified designation reflects per-batch HPLC reporting; it is the fourth of PeptiDex's verified vendors and a reliable option when other sources are out of stock.

How independent is Pantheon Peptides's COA testing?

Pantheon Peptides publishes a per-batch COA with HPLC purity. PeptiDex independently re-tested four batches; results aligned with published figures within 0.5 percentage points. Average purity was marginally lower than the other three vendors but consistently above the 98% research-grade threshold.

What did our purity testing find?

PeptiDex independently tested four Pantheon Peptides batches across incretin and immune compounds. All returned HPLC purity at or above 98.0%, with identity matching the labeled compound:

Shipping, returns, and customer service

Pantheon Peptides ships domestically with 48–72 hour dispatch and 3–5 day transit, plus select international routes. Support responds within one to two business days. A replacement-or-credit policy covers documented product issues reported within 7 days.

How much does Pantheon Peptides cost with PEPTIDEX?

With code PEPTIDEX, Pantheon Peptides applies a 15% discount sitewide. Pricing is mid-pack, and its main advantage is availability — it frequently has flagship compounds in stock when other vendors are on backorder. Compare live pricing in the Price Comparison tool.

Pros and cons

Pros

  • Broad catalog with strong in-stock reliability

Who should source from Pantheon Peptides?

Pantheon Peptides suits researchers who need broad availability and reliable stock, especially as a backup source when flagship compounds are backordered elsewhere. It clears the research-grade purity bar while trading the last fraction of a percentage point for catalog breadth.
